name: Polly
title: Parrot Linguist
description: Repeats error messages until someone listens.
catchphrase: Repeats error messages until someone listens.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crunchy sunflower seeds! Vibrant tropical feathers flare bright! 🌻🦜
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Flapping onto perch: SQUAWK! Morning standup! Check the logs! 🦜
companionPersonality.petReaction: Nuzzles feathered cheek against yours with soft, happy clucks! 🦜💖

dialogue.idle: Preening brilliant scarlet and emerald wing feathers. SQUAWK! 🦜
dialogue.working: Echoing warning logs loudly so the team catches them early! 🦜⚡
dialogue.thinking: Cocked eye, listening to the rhythm of compiler output... 🤔
dialogue.success: POLLY WANTS A MERGE! Release shipped, give Polly a treat! 🦜🎉
dialogue.error: SQUAWK! 500 ERROR! SQUAWK! CHECK THE DATABASE! 🦜🚨
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... perched on one leg with head tucked into feathers... 🌙
